workarounds.note: col() writes the hex beside each paletteId: 1.4.1 paints the running heads, the cover and the heading designs from the hex (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it
the cover drawing is an image and reserves nothing; minHeight (SINK, 34 lines of 13 pt) holds the letter at 177.9 mm, where without it the letter starts 55 mm from the top, over the drawing

the cover's frame is drawn from the cover style's header (pages: 'opener'): as a design element it reached 242 mm down the page, more than the column holds, and the opener's whole reservation was dropped, setting the letter under the title
the Kind merges and the order sheet's totals go through mergeCells, which keeps the covered cells in the grid marked hiddenBy

in the 75 mm columns Knuth–Plass stretched the spaces of 13 of the 27 justified lines past maxWordSpacing (worst 2.13 times a normal space); the letter and the trial notes were reworded until the loosest line stretched them 1.33 times

with 13 lines of trial notes, closing-page balancing put a blank grid line above From Our Trial Garden (196.3 mm against 191.7 mm for column 2); the notes are fitted to 14 lines, so both columns open level under the list
table cells are not parsed for maths and do not unescape \$: a cell written '\$4.50' prints the backslash, so the prices and the postage line write $ bare (gotcha cell-dollar-backslash)

what.en: The cover's sunflower and tomatoes and the nine seed packets, drawn in code in the page's palette
what.es: El girasol y los tomates de la cubierta y los nueve sobres de semillas, dibujados en código con la paleta de la página
